temporal_caption: At 0:00 a static security camera, 15 m up on the corner of the north-east red-brick building, looks south-west and steeply down over the whole intersection, which crosses the frame diagonally. On the left edge stands the south-east corner's pale-tiled building, in the top middle the south-west corner's red-brick building with its pale-tiled neighbour to its right, and at the right edge part of the north-west corner's grey-blue plaster building. The dark grey hatchback waits at the bottom left, the largest car in the frame; the blue sedan waits in the middle right; the white SUV is small at the top left, coming up the road; the two pedestrians are small figures on the crosswalk near the bottom centre, and the pedestrian in the green hoodie stands still on the corner in the middle left. At 0:01 the red sedan enters at the bottom right and drives up through the middle of the frame while the white SUV comes down through the middle; they pass each other in the centre at about 0:02, and the white SUV leaves at the bottom right just before 0:04. The red sedan grows smaller toward the top and is small at the top left by 0:07. The traffic light in the middle of the frame turns amber at 0:03 and red at 0:04. Just after 0:04 the dark grey hatchback pulls forward from the bottom left toward the bottom centre and the blue sedan starts moving, while the two pedestrians reach the sidewalks.

background_setting: A four-way city intersection on a clear afternoon, one lane each way: grey asphalt, white zebra crosswalks on all four sides, white stop lines and double yellow centre lines; concrete sidewalks with two old-style black street lamps, a red fire hydrant, a metal trash can and a grey utility box. Each corner has two buildings, the same in every view. North-east corner: a seven-storey red-brick building with a small security camera high on its corner, and beside it to the east a five-storey building faced in pale tiles. North-west corner: a seven-storey building in light grey-blue plaster, and beside it to the west a six-storey red-brick building. South-west corner: a five-storey red-brick building, and beside it to the west a five-storey building faced in pale tiles. South-east corner: a five-storey building faced in pale tiles, and beside it to the east a four-storey building in pale pink plaster. Every building has shop windows on the ground floor and rows of windows above. The four roads run straight out of the intersection with more buildings in the distance. There are no other vehicles, no parked cars, no cyclists and no other people: only the four cars and three pedestrians described.

actions.description: The north-south lights are green. The red sedan drives south and the white SUV drives north through the intersection, passing each other in the middle at about 0:02. The dark grey hatchback and the blue sedan wait at red lights on the east and west sides.
The pedestrian in the red jacket walks south and the pedestrian in the white shirt walks north across the zebra crosswalk on the east side, just in front of the waiting dark grey hatchback.
The north-south lights turn amber at 0:03, then red at 0:04.
Just after 0:04 the east-west lights turn green. The dark grey hatchback and the blue sedan pull away slowly and cross their stop lines at about 0:06.
The pedestrian in the green hoodie stands on the south-east corner filming north with a phone.
